route.direction: south-to-north; provider way directions are reversed relative to travel

selectionRecipe.coordinateSystem: WGS84; local equirectangular segment distance using 111,320m longitude scale at local mean latitude and 110,540m latitude scale
selectionRecipe.inclusion: building ways with one or more resolved vertices within 35m; qualifying tagged nodes/ways with one or more resolved vertices within 25m
selectionRecipe.qualification: building=*; natural=tree/tree_row; crossings; street lamps; benches; traffic signs/signals; address or POI tags; barrier/man_made and mapped street furniture
selectionRecipe.exclusions: untagged geometry, provider relations without Charlotte Street identity, and objects outside stated buffers
selectionRecipe.caveat: vertex-distance is deliberately conservative and may include corner/side-street structures; it does not establish which facade faces Charlotte Street or real-world completeness

attributeInterpretation.mapReported: Each entity tags object contains all provider-reported tags.
attributeInterpretation.inferred: No visual or real-world attribute is inferred from distance selection.
attributeInterpretation.unknown: Real-world presence beyond this mapped extract.
